# Changelog

## 0.1.4

- Expanded the EmDash peer dependency range so installs with EmDash 0.3.x do not warn.

## 0.1.3

- Added package-level plugin identity metadata and explicit no-permission descriptor metadata for marketplace trust review.

## 0.1.2

- Renamed the npm package to `emdash-page-list` for unscoped installs.
- Kept the trusted/native plugin ID as `page-list`; no content or settings migration is expected.

## 0.1.1

- Published the trusted/native Page List plugin for EmDash.
